data.name: Fredric
data.long_meaning: The name Fredric is derived from the Old High German name 'Freodric' or 'Freodor'. It is composed of two elements: 'Freod' meaning 'peace' or 'peaceful' and 'ric' or 'reik' meaning 'ruler' or 'power'. The name has been popularized in Western cultures, particularly in the English-speaking world.
